title: merremia umbellata var. cochleata

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
